message.content: The title of “best movie” can vary depending on who you ask—critics, audiences, or award bodies—but many consider **“Parasite”** (2019) to have carried its momentum into 2020, especially after winning the Academy Award for Best Picture in early 2020. In terms of pure box‑office performance and audience reception, **“Tenet”** (2020) was a major hit, while critically acclaimed releases like **“Soul”** (2020) and **“The Trial of the Chicago 7”** (2020) also received widespread praise. Ultimately, the “best” film depends on your criteria—whether you prioritize critical acclaim, box‑office success, cultural impact, or personal taste.
